title: Low-to-High Cable Fly
summary: A cable fly from low pulleys up to shoulder height, which biases the upper chest.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: cable station with an adjustable pulley.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for chest (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly chest total.
Library rating 0.4 for front delts (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly front delts total.

setup.text: Set both pulleys low and take a handle in each hand.
With a slight elbow bend, sweep your hands up and in to meet at about chin height.
Lower back out slowly to a stretch.

form_cues.cue: Sweep the hands up and in to chin height
Lead with the inside of your forearms, not your fists.

mistakes.text: Turning it into a front raise by shrugging.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Less upper-chest bias.
Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Less isolation, Less stable.
Swap sheet: Less upper-chest bias, Peak-contraction focus, Less constant tension.
